title: Rank Transform Of A Matrix
statement:
Given an `m x n` integer matrix `matrix`, return a matrix of positive integer ranks of the same shape. For every two cells in the same row or column, their ranks must have the same comparison as their values: a smaller value has a smaller rank, equal values have equal ranks, and a larger value has a larger rank.

Choose the ranks as small as possible while satisfying all comparisons. This minimum rank assignment is unique. Return the ranks in the original row and column order.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: matrix = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
Output: [[1, 2], [2, 3]]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: matrix = [[7, 7], [7, 7]]
Output: [[1, 1], [1, 1]]
```

### Example 3

```text
Input: matrix = [[20, -21, 14], [-19, 4, 19], [22, -47, 24], [-19, 4, 19]]
Output: [[4, 2, 3], [1, 3, 4], [5, 1, 6], [1, 3, 4]]
```

## Constraints

- m == matrix.length
- n == matrix[i].length
- 1 <= m, n <= 500
- -10^9 <= matrix[row][col] <= 10^9
